description: Per-scenario regression thresholds used by scripts/dev/perf-compare.py. See docs/plans/shipped/pillar-1-2-perf-review-system.md § D2 for rationale. mean_abs_ceiling_ms (Pillar 1 absolute mean budget on avgPerCallMs, target 6.94 = 1000/144) ARMED 2026-07-06 by the perf-gate step-5 calibration pass (docs/plans/shipped/perf-gate-step5-calibration.md): the observed ci-windows-latest distribution (docs/perf/calibration-observations.md, 6 green Perf PR-fast runs) had zero scopes above ~0.72 ms avgPerCallMs — 9.6x under budget — so it arms at the raw 6.94 with an EMPTY perScenario map (no legitimately-heavy scope exists). Baselines were recaptured (#1659) so rows carry p99Ms first. mean_min_abs_delta_ms is the noise floor for the relative lastTotalMs gate: a relative regression only fires when the absolute delta also exceeds it — calibrated 2026-06-07 from the first armed CI run, where ai_chat.history.render_turn flagged +12.0% on 0.023 -> 0.026 ms (3 µs of single-frame sampling noise); 0.05 ms = 0.7% of the 6.94 ms frame budget. p99_rel_pct + p99_min_abs_delta_ms are the RELATIVE p99 gate (Cluster-C ci-falsepositive-hardening; infra.md p99-gate-warmup-frame-exclusion follow-up): the absolute p99_abs_ceiling_ms (10 ms) catches a blowup but not a steady-state p99 that creeps up while staying under it. The relative gate closes that gap — it fires when a scope's p99 regresses by more than p99_rel_pct AND the absolute delta exceeds p99_min_abs_delta_ms. p99_rel_pct was ARMED 2026-07-14 (user sign-off) at 75.0 % with p99_min_abs_delta_ms = 1.5 ms, calibrated against the same 108-sample distribution as the mean gate (docs/perf/calibration-observations.md, 6 green Perf PR-fast runs × 18 snapshots): the hottest scope SmatchetUI::Draw carries baseline p99 ~0.74-0.79 ms and its worst observed p99 across all runs was 0.857 ms (priority-grid-scroll) — a positive run-to-run swing above baseline of only ~0.065 ms and a full run range of ~0.27 ms. 1.5 ms is ~5.5x that full range (~23x the positive swing), so the gate cannot fire on runner p99 noise; combined with the 75 % relative floor it fires only on a genuine p99 blowup to >=~2.3 ms that stays UNDER the 10 ms absolute ceiling (the gap the absolute p99 gate misses). Both conditions AND together. If a rare hot-job draw ever false-reds this, the perf-out-of-band label dismisses it; retighten/loosen only with fresh observed evidence + sign-off (never an autonomous flip).

perScenario.comment: Override the default for a specific scenarioId. Empty means inherit default. Tune ONLY when a real-world signal (CI false-positives, scenario noise) justifies it; document the rationale in the override entry. (2026-06-18: the cell-edit-burst p99_abs_ceiling_ms=15.0 override was REMOVED — its ~10.9 ms p99 was cold-start/warmup pollution, not a real edit-storm cost. cell-edit-burst was a 1-frame burst whose sample ring held only bootstrap frames; the p99-gate-warmup-frame-exclusion fix (#1385) gives it a steady-state window where SmatchetUI::Draw p99 is ~0.3 ms, so it now clears the global 10.0 ms floor and the override would only mask a real future regression. Resolves the verify-on-real-HW question in docs/plans/deferred/cell-edit-burst-p99-verify.md / Issue #973.)
